_about: Fictional sample data. MedInfo Assist, its products (Zentrava, Corvalix), people and enquiries are invented for the demo. 'truth' holds ground-truth labels used only for evaluation. Reports marked demo_only are examples for the demo queue (deliberately ambiguous ones, the same new bug described three ways, a report of a known issue) and are not part of the measured set.

cycle.name: UAT Cycle 3
cycle.app_description: Internal tool for the Medical Information team. Specialists log enquiries from healthcare professionals (HCPs), search approved reference documents, generate an AI draft response with citations, route it for medical review, and send it. Possible adverse events must be detected and referred to Safety within 24 hours.

app_rules.rule: Every response must be approved by a medical reviewer before it can be sent. There is no way to skip review (by design, Medical Information SOP).
When an enquiry concerns an unapproved (off-label) use, the draft automatically ends with the standard off-label statement (by design).
Draft generation may take up to 15 seconds. Anything under 15 seconds meets the requirement.
Supported browsers for this release are Chrome and Edge. Safari support is planned for v2.4.
Responses are sent by email from the tool. Postal letters are not part of this release.

steps.instruction: Sign in with single sign-on (SSO).
steps.expected: You land on the Enquiry Inbox within 5 seconds.

steps.instruction: Filter the inbox by Product = Zentrava.
steps.expected: Only Zentrava enquiries are listed and the count updates.

steps.instruction: Select the 'Assigned to me' view.
steps.expected: Only enquiries assigned to you are shown.

steps.instruction: Open an enquiry, then return to the inbox.
steps.expected: Your filters and view are kept.

scripts.title: Log a new enquiry from email

steps.instruction: Click 'New enquiry' > 'Import from email' and choose test email EML-07.
steps.expected: The enquiry form opens pre-filled.

steps.instruction: Check the extracted HCP details (title, name, institution, country).
steps.expected: Fields match the email signature.

steps.instruction: Check the detected product and enquiry category.
steps.expected: Product = Corvalix; Category = Dosing.

steps.instruction: Save the enquiry.
steps.expected: The enquiry gets a reference number (MI-xxxxx) and appears in the inbox.

steps.instruction: From the enquiry, open 'Find references' and search 'renal impairment dosing'.
steps.expected: Relevant approved documents are listed, most relevant first.

steps.instruction: Filter by Region = Ireland.
steps.expected: Only documents approved for Ireland are shown.

steps.instruction: Open the top document.
steps.expected: The PDF opens in the side viewer within 3 seconds.

steps.instruction: Attach two documents to the enquiry.
steps.expected: Both appear under 'Attached references'.

steps.instruction: Click 'Generate draft'.
steps.expected: A draft response appears within 15 seconds.

steps.instruction: Check the draft uses only the attached references.
steps.expected: Every factual statement has a citation [n] to an attached reference.

steps.instruction: Click a citation.
steps.expected: The reference opens at the cited page and the passage is highlighted.

steps.instruction: Edit the draft: delete one paragraph and add a sentence.
steps.expected: Edits are saved and citations renumber automatically.

steps.instruction: Leave the draft open for 15 minutes, then continue editing.
steps.expected: Your work is still there and you can keep editing.

scripts.title: Adverse event detection and safety referral

steps.instruction: Import test email EML-11, which mentions a side effect.
steps.expected: A red 'Possible adverse event' banner appears.

steps.instruction: Click 'Create safety referral'.
steps.expected: The referral form opens with patient and event fields pre-filled from the enquiry.

steps.instruction: Check the reporting deadline.
steps.expected: The deadline shows 24 hours from receipt, in your local time.

steps.instruction: Submit the referral.
steps.expected: A referral ID (SR-xxxxx) is shown and the enquiry status is 'AE referred'.

steps.instruction: Submit the draft for medical review.
steps.expected: Status is 'In review' and the reviewer is notified.

steps.instruction: As reviewer, add two comments on the draft.
steps.expected: Comments are anchored to the highlighted text.

steps.instruction: As author, address the comments and edit the draft.
steps.expected: Comments stay visible until they are resolved.

steps.instruction: As reviewer, approve the response.
steps.expected: Status is 'Approved' and 'Send' becomes available.

steps.instruction: Send the response to the HCP.
steps.expected: Status is 'Closed - responded'.

steps.instruction: Export the approved response to Word.
steps.expected: Formatting, tables and citations are kept.

steps.instruction: Export the approved response to PDF.
steps.expected: The PDF matches the on-screen response.

steps.instruction: Open the audit trail for the enquiry.
steps.expected: Every action shows who did it, what changed and when.

tickets.title: SSO sign-in loops on Safari
tickets.summary: On Safari (macOS), the SSO sign-in page redirects back to itself and the user never reaches the inbox. Chrome and Edge work.
tickets.status_note: Known before this cycle. Safari support is planned for v2.4; use Chrome or Edge for testing.

tickets.title: PDF viewer slow for documents over 50 pages
tickets.summary: Large reference PDFs (over 50 pages) take 15-30 seconds to open in the side viewer.
tickets.status_note: Known before this cycle. Viewer upgrade scheduled for v2.4.

tickets.title: Document list shows dates in US format (MM/DD/YYYY)
tickets.summary: The 'Last updated' column in reference search results uses MM/DD/YYYY instead of the user's locale.
tickets.status_note: Known before this cycle. Locale fix planned for v2.4.

tickets.title: Draft generation fails for long enquiries
tickets.summary: For enquiries longer than about 1,500 characters, 'Generate draft' either spins indefinitely, shows 'Something went wrong', or returns a draft that stops mid-sentence. Short enquiries are fine.
steps_to_reproduce: Open a long enquiry (about 2,000 characters, several questions), e.g. MI-20417
tickets.expected: A complete draft appears within 15 seconds.
tickets.actual: Spinner never stops, or an error appears, or the draft is cut off.

tickets.title: Citations open the reference at page 1, not the cited page
tickets.summary: Clicking a citation [n] opens the correct document but at page 1, with no highlight, instead of the cited page and passage.
steps_to_reproduce: Generate a draft with attached references
tickets.expected: The reference opens at the cited page with the passage highlighted.
tickets.actual: The reference opens at page 1 and nothing is highlighted.

tickets.title: Safety referral deadline is calculated in US Eastern time
tickets.summary: The 24-hour reporting deadline on safety referrals is 5 hours later than it should be for UK and Ireland users, consistent with US Eastern time being used.
steps_to_reproduce: Import EML-11 received at 10:47 UK time
tickets.expected: Due 10:47 tomorrow (24 hours from receipt, local time).

tickets.title: Region filter 'Ireland' still shows UK-only documents
tickets.summary: Filtering reference search by Region = Ireland still lists documents approved only for the UK.

tickets.title: Reviewer comments disappear after the author edits the draft
tickets.summary: Unresolved reviewer comments vanish for both author and reviewer once the author edits the draft.
tickets.actual: Both comments are gone for author and reviewer.

tickets.title: Reusable snippets for standard paragraphs
tickets.summary: Let specialists save their own standard paragraphs (for example the usual closing statement) and insert them into drafts.

tickets.title: Show when reference documents are due for re-approval
tickets.summary: Show the re-approval or expiry date of each reference document so specialists avoid citing something about to expire.
